messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> Service: inference-eu | Alert: high-p99 latency spike | PD:PD12345
incident-bot: Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345 | auto-escalation: enabled
jordan: acked and taking it. grabbing recent tail logs now. :eyes:
jordan: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l svc=inference-eu -o wide` to check pod state
ops-sre: saw a brief spike on autoscaler logs ~2m ago, might be slow to scale for long sequences. checking metrics
mira: adding customer-impact note: several mid-market customers reporting slow responses and a few 504s, not full outage yet
sam: oncall-swap ready if you want to hand it off, can take until you want to sleep :)
jordan: share logs I pulled: ```
2026-03-15T12:07:10Z inference-worker-7f8 cpu=92% mem=73% tail-latency=1.2s
2026-03-15T12:07:22Z inference-worker-7f8 kvcache-drop miss_ratio=0.28
2026-03-15T12:07:40Z autoscaler-trigger scale_from=3 to=5 reason=queue-depth
```
lee: quick check - is this single region? seen similar after model rollout last night?
jordan: rolling model rollout flagged yesterday but rolled back at 02:00 UTC, looks unrelated. sequence lengths trending higher tho
pagerduty-bot: PD12345: ack by jordan at 5601234335 | next escalation in 5m if not resolved
ops-sre: mitigation plan: 1) bump replica target to 8 for inference-eu 2) enable prefix cache bypass for heavy seqs 3) throttle low-priority tenants briefly. executing step 1 now
jordan: running `kubectl scale deployment/inference-eu --replicas=8 -n inference` -> sent
ops-sre: scale command accepted, pods starting. watching readiness.
lee: if scaling doesn't bring down tail maybe force kvcache warmup script? I can run warmup on new instances
mira: I'll ping support and product ops with ETA and mitigation steps. drafting a short customer message: "We're seeing increased latency; temporary autoscale + throttling applied; investigating root cause; will update in 10 minutes."
sam: taking ownership at 5601234380 — jordan handing off (need me to dive into kvcache or continue with scaling checks?)
jordan: handoff to sam: I gathered logs and sequence-length histograms in /tmp/pd12345-handoff.log. priority=investigate kvcache miss + autoscale latency.
sam: got it, running kvcache-warmup on one new pod and watching tail latency
incident-bot: Note: runbook matched: inference-tail-latency -> follow scale + kvcache warmup steps (runbook v2)
ops-sre: warmup script started on pod inference-worker-12: `./kv_warmup --keys=top10k --threads=4`
lee: monitoring shows p99 dropped from 1.2s to 0.6s on warmup pod, others following. :thumbsup:
mira: customer message sent to affected customers, included status page link and mitigation steps.
pagerduty-bot: PD12345: ownership transferred to sam at 5601234385 | escalation suppressed
sam: continuing to observe for 10m then will close if stable. will post final notes & postmortem tasks
jordan: thanks team. leaving notes in the ticket: root suspect = kvcache cold + scaling lag; follow-up: improve autoscaler policy and add proactive kvcache prewarm during rollouts
ops-sre: filing follow-up ticket INF-789 for autoscaler tuning and INF-790 for kvcache prewarm ops
incident-bot: Page resolved (manual) by sam at 5601234446 | resolution: p99 reduced to baseline, no more 504s
mira: marking customer impact: degraded perf, transient 504s, no data loss. next: coordinate postmortem and changelog
sam: closing thread, will add timeline + artifacts to the incident board. :white_check_mark:
